title: Chris Mellon's aerospace insider contact died before they could meet

tellings.quote: claims he almost met with someone from the UFO program

There's a Chris Mellon story where he's supposed to meet with somebody on the program and he has the meeting all set up and two weeks before the meeting, he says that the guy just randomly has a heart attack.
tellings.difference: This telling says how and when the contact died: a sudden heart attack two weeks before the meeting that had been set up.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings are Jesse Michels passing on Chris Mellon's story about a contact from the UFO program who died before the two of them could meet.

as_told.title: Chris Mellon's program contact dies of heart attack before meeting

plain: Chris Mellon, a former Pentagon intelligence official, is said to have set up a meeting with someone who worked inside a secret UFO program, and the man died before they could meet. Michels tells it twice, passing on what he says Mellon has said: once he says only that Mellon "almost met with someone from the UFO program", and the second time he adds that the meeting was all arranged and that two weeks before it, the man "just randomly has a heart attack." If true, it would mean a rare insider source was lost just before he could speak.
